resources.string: NDSBrewer needs full file access to read your DS ROMs and build forwarders in the same profile folder SweepDSEmu uses. Grant "Allow management of all files" on the next screen.
Pick the same folder you selected in SweepDSEmu (e.g. AzaharPlus) so NDSBrewer can find your DS ROMs and register forwarders in the same place.
That folder couldn\'t be opened. Please pick your SweepDSEmu profile folder.
That folder is on removable/SD card storage, which isn\'t supported yet. Please pick a folder on your device\'s main storage instead.
Install after building (deletes the .cia once installed)
No .nds/.dsi ROMs found in sdmc/roms/nds or sdmc/roms/dsi.
SweepDSEmu isn\'t installed -- install it to enable one-tap installing. The .cia was still saved to ndsbrewer_output/ in your profile folder.
Couldn\'t hand off to SweepDSEmu (mismatched app signature) -- the .cia was still saved to ndsbrewer_output/ in your profile folder for manual install.
This removes %1$s from the 3DS HOME Menu and deletes its installed data. The original DS ROM is not affected.
